why: This is a study-specific, mathematics- and ratio-focused framework for measuring teachers' CK and PCK, not a general theory of learning or teaching; its rubric and coding results are measurement details and an empirical finding.
C-K theory is a design-process framework for generating products and solutions, and its use here is a course-specific workshop implementation rather than a general theory of learning.
This is a five-class sequence designed for a specific cohort of third-year Film undergraduates, so it is a setting-specific instructional design rather than a general reusable pattern.

This is a narrower application condition for fostering creative thinking: use generative, flexible assignments and avoid treating fixed, calculation-based tasks as suitable for creativity-oriented design.
CKAPQ is a named, psychometrically validated questionnaire and assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: CKAPQ — Comprehensive Knowledge, Attitude, and Practice Questionnaire for e-learning utilization
product_description: A 16-item, five-construct, 5-point Likert questionnaire developed by Kumar Archana Prabu et al. to assess undergraduate medical and dental students' knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding e-learning utilization.
